North-east of Liberty Bay on the island Vandura there's a cave in which voodoo cultists are hiding. The entrance is hidden in the yard of one of the sheds, here (32359, 32721, 7). The cultists have planted a Jungle Maw near the entrance to prevent anyone from getting in. As well as cult members, other fearsome monsters have made their home inside the cave.

This area is one of the few areas home to the Voodoo Cultists, and as such is a good place to hunt for Rope Belts. The cave is also home to the Mana Draining creatures from Bonelords and Elder Bonelords, which may discourage low-level Mages from hunting there as the damage dealt can easily overwhelm them as they struggle to heal whilst their mana is being drained.

This page contains information which could be considered quest spoiling.


Cult Cave

Deeper Cult Cave

This cave contains all different Cult members except Enlighteneds among other Creatures.
You need to have learned all four Verses of the Hymn in order to play the Piano, to reach the deeper parts.
After Successfully playing the secret cult hymn, you will be teleported to a room on the other side of the wall. There aren't any monsters, but only teleporter to go back to piano room and stairs to access first of two levels of Deeper Cult Cave.
